name: Hunt Lab — DFIR-RansomHub-2025-Lab Coverage
description: ATT&CK techniques exercised by the Hunt Lab recreation of The DFIR Report's June 2025 RansomHub case (Hide Your RDP: Password Spray Leads to RansomHub Deployment). Each highlighted technique maps to one or more abilities in the DFIR-RansomHub-2025-Lab Caldera adversary. Drop this layer into https://mitre-attack.github.io/attack-navigator/.

techniques.comment: rh-01-recon-domain — net group 'Domain Admins' /domain, nltest, whoami /all
rh-02-recon-network — PowerShell sweep of 192.168.56.0/24 (substitute for Advanced IP Scanner)
rh-03-creds-lsass — Atomic Red Team T1003.001 Test 1 (comsvcs.dll MiniDump)
rh-04-creds-sam — Atomic Red Team T1003.002 Test 1 (reg save SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM)
rh-05-disc-fileshare — net view + recursive walk of \\win-server\Finance
rh-06-evasion-symlink — fsutil behavior set SymlinkEvaluation R2L:1 R2R:1
rh-07-tool-rclone-dl + rh-08-tool-stage-artifacts — rclone.exe pulled at runtime; nocmd.vbs / rcl.bat / include.txt staged
rh-09-exfil-rclone — wscript → cmd → rclone copy to s3://ransomhub-exfil-lab on LocalStack
rh-10-impact-vss — Atomic Red Team T1490 Test 1 (vssadmin Delete Shadows /all /quiet)
rh-11-impact-encrypt — fake_amd64.ps1 (benign rename + ransom-note drop in C:\Shares\Finance)
rh-12-evasion-clearlogs — Atomic Red Team T1070.001 Test 1 (wevtutil cl Application/System/Security)
rh-dwell-1/2/3 — three dwell abilities model attacker idle time between phases (foothold, post-creds, pre-impact)
